provenance.note: CUDEM spatial metadata: footprints of the source datasets the tile was gridded from, generated at 1/3 arc-second and vectorised (Amante et al. 2023 s2.4). Cells outside every polygon are interpolated (GMT surface) from the bathymetric pre-surface and the coastline mask. Geometry simplified at 1e-5 deg (~1 m; source polygons are vectorised 1/3 arc-second cells, ~10 m).
